q2_gaps: a relational-noun complement inside a KIND-level copular predicate ('a watch is a period of the night') - the genitive PartOf/Possession route is specified for individual referents, and nothing says whether the of-restriction rides the subject kind, the predicate nominal, or a fused property (the kind-level fusion route exists only for an ADJECTIVE's PP complement, e.g. sensitive_to_light)
notes: Indefinite copular definitional reading (Inheritance, definitional 0.99) and the bare generic 'night' filler are both correct. PartOf is a licensed head but is used here with two kinds, which the instruction set's part-of-object / member-of-group jobs do not describe.
